data.title: Apartment handover appointment on 15 March 2025
data.summary: Beispiel Immobilienverwaltung GmbH confirms receipt of your termination of the tenancy effective 31 March 2025. It proposes an apartment handover inspection on 15 March 2025 at 09:30.
data.explanation: Your landlord's property manager confirmed your termination and proposed a handover (Wohnungsabnahme) appointment. Meet in front of the apartment door, hand over all five keys, and read the meters together. Return the apartment broom-clean and without fixtures that weren't there at the start of the tenancy. If the time doesn't suit you, contact the manager to arrange another one. The letter states no consequences if you miss it.
